title: Watch the fusion point of two breaths
caption:
There is a moment when the breath is neither coming in nor going out. It is still. In that stillness, you are near your center.

Technique 3 of 112. A child breathes from the belly and lives from the center. Breathe deep and slow, and touch the center where the two breaths meet.

Save this for your evening sit.

Technique and sutra from Osho, The Book of Secrets.
